name: Barcode Check Digit Calculator
desc: Calculate or verify EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8 and GTIN-14 check digits
seoTitle: Barcode Check Digit Calculator (EAN, UPC, GTIN)
seoDescription: Calculate the check digit for EAN-13, UPC-A, EAN-8 and GTIN-14, or verify a full barcode number. Free GS1 check digit calculator.
intro: Every EAN, UPC and GTIN number ends with a check digit that catches typing mistakes. Enter the digits without the last one to calculate it, or enter the full number to check that it is valid.
steps: Enter the digits without the check digit to calculate it, or the full number to verify it.

faq.q: How is the check digit calculated?
faq.a: Digits are weighted alternately by 3 and 1 from the right, added up, and the check digit is the amount needed to reach the next multiple of 10 (the GS1 method).

faq.q: Does a valid check digit mean the product number is registered?
faq.a: No. It only shows the number is correctly formed. Registered numbers come from GS1 or your national GS1 organisation.
